Definition: from a derivative of G5188; stormy (as if smoky):--tempestuous.
BiblicalUsage: typhōnikós stands behind the English phrase tempestuous, stormy. In Acts 27:14, not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put typhōnikós exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
